days_meaning: each delivery day adds this much cash to your side

messages.text: Happy to deliver Fiesta de San Cayetano at 163 primas with 10 delivery days - a fair deal we can sign right away.
Hello, and thank you for meeting me. I would propose 131 P with delivery on day 0.
I appreciate it, thank you. Could we close at 92 P, delivery on day 10, please?
Happy to deliver on day 0 as you first asked: 143 P, day 0, and we can close today.
